variants.headline: New settlers land from the ship
variants.sub: The ship in port has brought new settlers who landed at {district}.
variants.body:
New settlers have landed from the ship at {district}. The number arriving is {migrants}. Their arrival is an entry into the colony, not a complete account of the lives that follow. For {target}, the relevant question concerns responsibility towards newcomers as people rather than merely an addition to a count.

Our movement believes belonging should have a political meaning beyond a greeting. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: An arrival becomes a colonial beginning
variants.sub: The district {district} has received new settlers landing from the ship.
variants.body:
The ship in port has brought {migrants} new settlers, landing at {district}. A voyage's arrival can be recorded plainly while leaving room for the human meaning of beginning somewhere. Readers considering {target} should distinguish the landing from unreported arrangements for housing, employment or the newcomers' future circumstances.

Our movement believes belonging should have a political meaning beyond a greeting. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Newcomers step into the colony's life
variants.sub: New settlers have landed from the ship at {district}.
variants.body:
The district {district} has received {migrants} settlers landing from the ship. The arrival concerns people joining the colony's life, without supplying a personal history for each one. An assessment of {target} should keep their human place in view without promising outcomes that the fact of landing cannot establish.

Our movement believes belonging should have a political meaning beyond a greeting. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
